title: Tech Note: Creating a Splashscreen on Mac OS

historical_commentary.text: This Mac-only technique relied on Macintosh resource fork manipulation, a concept that has been entirely deprecated in modern macOS. The desire for custom splash screens persists, but modern approaches use completely different mechanisms. Resource forks were a unique feature of classic Mac OS file systems.
related_updates: Classic Mac OS resource forks are no longer used in modern macOS
Custom splash screens in modern 4D are handled through different mechanisms
The technique was Mac OS-only and has no modern equivalent using resources
